faq.a: Saturday 3 October 2026 at Riverside East, 5 Thornton Street, Stratford, London E20 2AD.
Durkin FC beat Donis Futbol Club 4–3 in the final. The score is in the published London 26 results.

faq.q: How many teams and games were recorded?
faq.a: The published scoreboard lists 12 men's teams and 38 completed games: 33 men's games and five legends games. Those final scores contain 313 goals.

faq.q: What happened in the legends round?
faq.a: The published scores show five legends-round games. Donis finished top of the recorded table on six points.

faq.q: How did the fan MVP vote finish?
faq.a: The public fan vote tally recorded 188 votes across the day. Voting is closed.

faq.q: Where can I see the results?
faq.a: The Games page at donis.shotclubhouse.com/london-26/games holds the final scores, knockout bracket and tables.
Men's games were 2v2 on concrete in street shoes, with squads of up to four. The group stage led to two semi-finals and a final.
Explore the Essex 27 event preview and join the Donis updates list for confirmed event and Clubhouse news.

sponsors.name: Favela Cerveja
blurb: Favela is a premium beer built to capture the taste of Rio. It was started by father and son Charles and Fred Gay.
The range is a crisp 5% lager and Ipanema, a light 5% IPA with citrus notes. Both are vegan and gluten-free.
A share of every sale goes to The Favela Foundation, which funds grassroots education and community projects in Brazil's favelas.

sponsors.name: Flair Digital Agency
blurb: Flair is a founder-focused digital agency for growing businesses in London, Berkshire and across the UK, set up in October 2024.
It covers brand design, paid search and social campaigns, social media management, personal brands for founders, and SEO.
It also sponsors football from England Beach Soccer and Reading FC to grassroots clubs in Berkshire.

sponsors.name: SHOT Clubhouse
blurb: SHOT Clubhouse brings a whole club into one app: teams, fixtures, announcements and the people in it.
For London 26 it ran this site, the matchday scores and tables on phones, and the big screen at the cage.
